source_row.rationale: States vary significantly in their regulatory approach to nurse staffing — some states (such as California) have legally mandated minimum nurse-to-patient ratios, while others require hospital staffing committees with nurse input, public reporting of staffing levels, or have no specific staffing legislation at all, reflecting an evolving and geographically varied policy landscape.
source_row.source_detail: State nurse-staffing laws vary by jurisdiction and are not uniform nationwide; currentness checked 2026-08-14.
source_row.source_name: ANA — State Nurse Staffing Legislation Overview
